name: selfheal_incidents_deepseek_20261103
comment: ANCHOR: SELFHEAL_INCIDENTS_DEEPSEEK_20261103 — the one-incident reopen helper refuses operator-only scopes (SIEM/ledger/credential) even when the config regex omits them; the supervisor cap route reads the real L.attempt() row shape and an unparseable tail is never a no-op; the DeepSeek key is read on the host and crosses as the first stdin line into a memfd, never env/argv/path. Hermetic: temp ledgers, fake key files, fake CLI; no network and no live state.

test_self_heal_deepseek_launch_20261103.py proves the launcher contract (descriptor naming, cwd, no ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN/API_KEY, rc=2 without a descriptor) and test_self_heal_deepseek_wiring_20261103.py proves the fixer side hands the key line over and the launcher chain keeps it out of the env.
